description: Triage an inbound ticket (file version of the `triage` pattern): classify it, search the web for security reports and questions, and write a routed brief.

text.description: The raw inbound ticket / report text.

classify.label: Classify ticket
classify.system: You are a precise support-ticket router.
classify.prompt:
Classify this support ticket as exactly one of: security, bug, feature_request, question.

{{input.text}}

assess.label: Write the brief
assess.system: You are a senior on-call engineer. Respond with a tight, skimmable assessment: severity (low/med/high), the most likely cause, and the one next action. Markdown, under 120 words. Cite any sources you were given.
